title: 第五章 这就是开了顶级画质的技能效果！
slug: 次元法典全本免费-次元法典最新章节列表
content_zh:
虽然方正很想选择【冰霜打击】，但是他考虑再三，还是选择了【十字军打击】。原因也很简单，他可以想象在主世界那群人这会儿肯定早就发现了被自己干掉的那些骑士的尸体，虽然方正不确定对方能够从那些尸体上查找到多少线索，但可以想象他们绝对会掌握一部分情报。如果自己学习了【冰霜打击】，那么很容易引起那些骑士的注意。毕竟死亡骑士和巫妖王系出同门，只要不是傻瓜，看几次方正的战斗立刻就可以猜到这两者之间的关联，与其主动送个把柄给主世界那些圣骑士，还不如反其道而行之，至少一个使用神圣力量的人，不会让人联想到巫妖王这种不死的王者身上去。
“叮！”
方正话音刚落，就听见耳边传来一阵轻响，随后他眼前顿时晕眩了一下，接着就感觉到自己的脑中忽然出现了一些从来没有见过的资料，随后方正眼前再次浮现出了一行系统提示。
【已习得十字军打击】
【持有技能：十字军打击】
【熟练度：D（入门）】
【可升级】
看到这里，方正又愣了一下，他成了五等分。方正伸出手去点了一下，很快又一条提示出现在他的眼前。
【是否使用次元点数，提升熟练等级？】
“否。”
看着眼前的系统提示，方正果断选择了拒绝升级，作为这个系统的设计者，方正当然清楚这是个什么东西。次元点数可是非常珍贵的，按照之前方正的设计来看的话，十个次元点数可以召唤一枚灵魂石，现在方正手中的这个次元法典基本上就是一个不能氪金的手游系统。而常识也告诉他，既然不能氪金，那么那些可以用来抽卡的石头，自然是要先攒下来，不能乱用的。
这是一个非酋的自我修养。
在做完这一切之后，方正关闭系统，再次望向四周。虽然他看起来思考了很久，但事实上只过了不到半分钟的时间。此刻那些民兵也开始处理四周的活死人，做好再一次的战斗准备。之前的胜利让他们本来低落的士气提升了一些，但是每个人面上还是阴云遍布。
不过在方正看来这也很正常，外面几乎到处都是不死的亡灵，相比之下，崔斯特姆的人手根本不够，依靠小镇的防御或许他们能够躲过一时，但万一那些亡灵联合起来，那么崔斯特姆就一定会沦陷。
他们现在所做的，终究只是垂死挣扎而已。
“咚咚咚………”
就在这个时候，忽然，一阵沉重的脚步声传来，而听到这脚步声，民兵们也急忙停下了手中的动作，向着声音发出的方向望去。很快，一个身影出现在了他们的眼前。她穿着厚重的白色盔甲，手中还拿着长剑与盾牌，看到这经典的装扮，方正甚至不用猜就能够知道她的真实身份了。
圣教军！
奈非天闪亮登场啦！
在方正的注视下，那个圣教军就这么走到了拉姆福德队长的面前，然后放下手中的盾牌，冲着拉姆福德队长点了点头。

“我是信奉萨卡兰姆的圣教军，我看见有一颗陨星掉进了这个镇子。”
“圣教军？”
听到这个名字，拉姆福德队长似乎松了口气，接着他耸耸肩膀，开口说道。
“它砸在了老教堂的房顶上，当时只有一个幸存者———莉娅，你应该和她谈谈………”
但是拉姆福德队长的话还没有说完，忽然，一个民兵大声尖叫起来。
“队长，它们又来了！”
“什么？”
听到民兵的说话，拉姆福德队长顿时一惊，而方正也急忙转头向着旁边望去。在他们的注视下，地面逐渐开始隆起，随后，一个个全身灰白的活死人从里面爬了出来，摇摇晃晃的冲着众人走去。
“该死！”
看见这一幕，拉姆福德队长也是皱起了眉头，接着他一个箭步冲了上去。
“先把这波活死人摆平了再来给你开门吧，其他人，我们上！”
听到拉姆福德队长的命令，方正再次握紧霜之哀伤，不过这一次他望向那些活死人的目光可是跃跃欲试。
自己现在可是学会了十字军打击！难道还对付不了这群丧尸？
想到这里，方正也是迎上了其中一个活死人，接着他高高举起手中的霜之哀伤，用力向下一挥。

content_en:
Although Fang Zheng wanted to choose [Frost Strike], he thought twice and chose [Crusader Strike]. The reason is also very simple. He can imagine that the group of people in the main world must have discovered the corpses of the knights he killed. Although Fang Zheng is not sure how many clues the other party can find from those corpses, he can imagine that they will definitely have some information. If you learn [Frost Strike], you can easily attract the attention of those knights. After all, the Death Knight and the Lich King are from the same sect. As long as you are not a fool, you can immediately guess the connection between the two after watching a few battles between Fang Zheng and Fang Zheng. Instead of actively giving a clue to the Paladins in the main world, it is better to do the opposite. At least a person who uses holy power will not be associated with an immortal king like the Lich King.
"Ding!"
As soon as Fang Zheng finished speaking, he heard a soft sound in his ears, and then he felt dizzy for a moment. Then he felt that some information he had never seen before suddenly appeared in his mind, and then a line of system prompts appeared in front of Fang Zheng's eyes again.
[Has learned Crusader Strike]
[Skill held: Crusader Strike]
[Proficiency: D (entry level)]
[upgradeable]
Seeing this, Fang Zheng was stunned again, and he became a fifth. Fang Zheng stretched out his hand and clicked it, and soon another prompt appeared in front of him.
[Do you want to use dimensional points to improve your proficiency level? 】
"No."
Looking at the system prompts in front of him, Fang Zheng decisively chose to refuse the upgrade. As the designer of this system, Fang Zheng certainly knew what this was. Dimension points are very precious. According to Founder's previous design, ten dimensional points can summon a soul stone. The dimensional code in Founder's hands now is basically a mobile game system that cannot be used for money. And common sense also told him that since he couldn't earn gold, those stones that could be used to draw cards must be saved first and not used randomly.
This is the self-cultivation of an African chieftain.
After doing all this, Fang Zheng turned off the system and looked around again. Although he seemed to have been thinking for a long time, in fact only less than half a minute passed. At this moment, the militiamen also began to deal with the living dead around them, preparing for another battle. The previous victory had improved their already low morale, but there were still clouds on everyone's face.
However, in Fangzheng's view, this is normal. There are undead undead almost everywhere outside. In comparison, Tristram's manpower is simply not enough. They may be able to escape for a while relying on the town's defense, but if the undead unite, Tristram will definitely fall.
What they are doing now is just a desperate struggle.
"Dong dong dong..."
At this moment, suddenly, there was a sound of heavy footsteps. When they heard the footsteps, the militiamen hurriedly stopped what they were doing and looked in the direction of the sound. Soon, a figure appeared in front of them. She was wearing thick white armor and holding a long sword and shield in her hands. Seeing this classic outfit, Fang Zheng knew her true identity without even guessing.
Crusaders!
The Nephalem make their grand appearance!
Under Fang Zheng's gaze, the Crusader walked up to Captain Rumford, then put down the shield in his hand and nodded at Captain Rumford.
"I am a Crusader who believes in Zakarum. I saw a meteor falling into this town."
"The Crusaders?"
Captain Rumford seemed relieved when he heard the name, then he shrugged his shoulders and spoke.
"It hit the roof of the old church. There was only one survivor - Leah, you should talk to her..."
But Captain Rumford had not finished speaking. Suddenly, a militiaman screamed loudly.cried out.
"Captain, they're here again!"
"What?"
Hearing the words of the militiamen, Captain Rumford was suddenly startled, and Fang Zheng also hurriedly turned his head and looked to the side. Under their gaze, the ground gradually began to rise, and then, one by one, the gray living dead crawled out and staggered toward the crowd.
"Damn it!"
Seeing this scene, Captain Rumford also frowned, and then he rushed forward with a lunge.
"Let's deal with this wave of living dead first, and then I'll open the door for you. Everyone else, let's go!"
After hearing Captain Rumford's order, Fang Zheng once again grasped Frostmourne, but this time he looked at the living dead with eager eyes.
I have now learned the Crusader Strike! Isn't it possible to deal with these zombies?
Thinking of this, Fang Zheng also faced one of the living dead, then he raised the Frostmourne in his hand high and waved it down with all his strength.
